title: 根Gradle配置变更撤销输入匹配
prompt: 执行本任务的构建与测试并保存证据

gradlew.content:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
case "$1" in
assembleDebug)
 mkdir -p app/build/outputs/apk/debug
 printf E2E-APK > app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
 ;;
testDebugUnitTest)
 mkdir -p app/build/test-results/testDebugUnitTest
 cat > app/build/test-results/testDebugUnitTest/TEST-example.xml <<'REPORT'
<testsuite tests="2" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="one"/><testcase name="two"/></testsuite>
REPORT
 ;;
esac
echo BUILD SUCCESSFUL
